title: Teach the Plan stage the RiskRegister template before Risk review
goal: PROBLEM: The Plan stage prompt asks for a detailed implementation plan but never mentions the RiskRegister template (docs/Reliability&Risk/RiskRegister/Template.md), while the Risk review stage fails plans whose risk section lacks the template's required fields (Score, Impact C/I/A, Likelihood, Prevention, Detection, Response, Starting Step on ladder 1-9 with Why, Tags). Every task therefore pays at least one plan -> risk-review-fail -> replan cycle for a purely formal omission, even when the plan is technically strong. FIX: Make the requirement visible where the plan is written: add the template checklist to the Plan stage prompt (or its planning skill), and/or add a cheap pre-risk-review format validator (for example extend the docs check) that lists missing template fields before the plan reaches Risk review. Do not weaken Risk review itself. ACCEPTANCE: (1) a newly planned task includes a Template-conformant risk block without a format-driven failback; (2) the validator (if built) names the exact missing fields. CASE STUDY: KainBain task cf4b6847-11eb-4d59-b39e-e31b31df1150: Risk review failed the plan twice on 2026-11-19 (risk-review-failure-20261119-132340 and -132513, the second explicitly noting the plan was 'technically strong' but formally non-compliant) and cited prior identical FAILs on other tasks (ac988ba8, 8dafdce1), proving this is systemic, not a one-off. See docs/tasks/cf4b6847-11eb-4d59-b39e-e31b31df1150/.
